editorial: We visited in August, which is not Langkawi's driest period, and got some gloomy weather. It did not ruin the trip, but the island would obviously benefit from clearer skies.

For this KL-plus-Langkawi itinerary, we'd favour the drier months on the west coast if dates are flexible. Kuala Lumpur itself is hot and humid year-round, so weather optimisation matters more for the beach than the city.
